question: How are striking and deluding related to the eightfold samaya conduct of mantra and tantra?
premises: Striking and deluding are named among the pledges.
The pledges form an eightfold set articulated in eight ways.
This set expresses the nature of mantra and tantra as a unified samaya conduct.
inference: Therefore, even forceful ritual acts are integrated into a structured eightfold samaya discipline of mantra and tantra.
uncertainties: The ritual sense of hanana and mohana here may be technical rather than literal.
plain_english: Striking and deluding, and so on, belong to an eightfold set of pledges expressed in eight ways, forming the unified samaya conduct that reflects the nature of mantra and tantra.
